title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Existing monumental Spaces engine + fixed frontal camera
preserve: mobile controls cannot trigger text selection/callout UI

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v18 keeps Maps 1-2 and adds three new walkable scenes: Map 3 a straight axial road with exact opposing column pairs; Map 4 an enclosing textured barrel tunnel with an absorbing black throat; Map 5 a ritual striped avenue with paired pointed spires, orange sky and a stepped temple destination.

open_feedback: Review Map 3 axial clarity: road must stay straight and every left column must have an exact right counterpart at the same depth.
Review Map 4: tunnel should read as an enclosing barrel/tube with continuous stone material and a strong dark vanishing throat, not as a flat hallway.
Review Map 5: striped road, paired pointed spires, orange ritual sky and stepped temple should reproduce the supplied reference's strong central perspective without copying it literally.
Review performance and touch movement across all five scenes.
